name: What permits are required for custom swimming pool construction in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for custom swimming pool construction in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Los Angeles, custom swimming pool construction requires various permits, primarily from the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety (LADBS). This typically includes a building permit, electrical permit, and plumbing permit. Depending on the project's scope and location (e.g., hillside, coastal zones), additional permits for grading, retaining walls, or environmental review might be necessary. Our firm manages the entire permitting process for you.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom pool construction in Los Angeles requires building, electrical, and plumbing permits from LADBS, with additional permits possibly needed for specific site conditions.
